# CV-19 — Search in ⌘K and Chat's Search

> Branch `t/maciej/cv-19-search-2` (from `t/maciej/cv-19-search`, merged once with the build head after CV-10-fix, CV-11, CV-17 and CV-13) · head: the commit that updates this file · status: built, not landed
> Migration: `supabase/migrations/20261016190000_chat_v2_search.sql` · applied to the local stack: **yes** (2026-10-16, as `supabase_admin`, after a rolled-back dry run with `chat_search.test.sql`); every object it uses re-checked against the live stack first (`chat__readable_channel_ids(uuid,uuid)` unchanged; `attachments` as CV-9 left it). `bun run db:test chat`: all 21 files pass.

## Delivered against the row

- **`chat_search(ws, query, channel?, before?, before_id?, limit, from?, after?, has_file?)`**: `SECURITY DEFINER`, `search_path = ''`, people only (granted to `authenticated`, not to anon or the service role). Messages of conversations the caller can read right now, newest first, at most 50, keyset paging by `(created_at, id)`; each row names its conversation (kind, name), author and a snippet whose matches sit between U+E000 and U+E001 (plain text, no HTML).
- **The read rule** is the live `chat__readable_channel_ids(ws, person)` (CV-2b), applied once per call inside the indexed query (spike 5's strategy C). A parity check proves it equals `chat_can_read_channel` for every conversation and person.
- **`chat__search_query`** (server-only): websearch syntax over the unaccented text, at most 256 characters and 32 words, each word of 3+ letters a prefix, punctuation-only input → nothing; never raises. **`chat_headline`**: a display-only text search config so "zolw" marks "żółw".
- **⌘K** (`global-command-palette.tsx`): **Messages** (top five from `chat_search`, snippet marked, author · conversation) and **Conversations** (top five `chat_channel` registry rows, which already follow the read rule), then **See all in Chat**. A failed message search reads "Search isn't available"; the palette's "No results." never shows while that is the case.
- **Chat's Search** (`src/features/chat/find/chat-search-view.tsx`, `/chat?view=search&q=…&from=&in=&file=1&date=`): title, the words, the FilterBar (from · in · has a file · date), People found by name (Polish without diacritics, from the member list, opening a direct message), then Messages with "Show older". Opened by "See all in Chat", the bottom bar's Search while Chat is open, and the find bar's "See all".
- **A conversation's own Search** (`find/find-bar.tsx`): the toolbar's Search opens a find bar under the toolbar; ↑/↓ or Enter/Shift+Enter step newest → oldest, "n of m" ("50+" when a page is full), the stream lands on each hit (`m=`, a chain reply also opens its chain); Esc closes.
- **⌘J**: nothing is bound to it (v1's binding left with CV-8a); the e2e asserts a press does nothing.
- v1's unused client-side `chat.search` (an `ilike` over `body`) is removed from the runtime and its type.

## Agent's choices (deferred to by Maciej: confirmed for building, may be reconsidered)

- **The read rule reuses the live 2-argument helper**, not the draft's new 1-argument one · agent · CV-2b already shipped `chat__readable_channel_ids(ws, person)` with server-only grants; a second form would be a parallel rule · rejected: the spike's draft overload.
- **An app's key gets nothing from `chat_search`** (no grant to the service role; `auth.uid()`, not `perm_actor_id()`) · agent · the brief leaves the key path to CV-21, and reading as the key's creator would include their direct messages · rejected: the draft's creator fallback.
- **"Has a file" is a parameter now** (`p_has_file`: a ready, not-deleted `attachments` row for the message) · agent · the table and its index exist; CV-9 uses the same predicates · rejected: waiting for CV-9.
- **Hits carry their conversation's kind and name** · agent · ⌘K has no chat store to name a conversation; the caller can read it, so naming it says nothing new · rejected: a second read per hit.
- **Input bounds instead of a promised timeout**: 256 characters, 32 words, 50 rows; the function also carries `statement_timeout = 5s`, which bounds a call through the API but not a direct SQL call · agent · Postgres arms the timer at statement start, so only the API path honours it. **Checked on the local stack's PostgREST v14.5** with a throwaway function (`SET statement_timeout = '1s'`, sleeps 3 s, dropped after): cut at ~1,040 ms with 57014; the same body without the setting was cut at 3,004 ms by `anon`'s role timeout (3 s). So through the API the 5 s applies; without it, `authenticated`'s role timeout (8 s) is the backstop.
- **`search.ts` stays** (the brief said to delete it): it is the `/chat` link's params module (CV-8b's `view=browse`), not v1's search; it gains `view=search`, `q`, `from`, `in`, `file`, `date` · agent · deleting it would break the route.
- **The toolbar's Search opens the find bar** (round 5 frame 2 "find", its button "Search in this conversation"), and the bar's "See all" opens Chat's Search with "in: this conversation" · agent · the spec lists the toolbar among Chat's Search openers and also names "the conversation's own Search"; the frame draws the find bar, so both are kept · rejected: the toolbar opening Chat's Search directly (the frame's bar would have no entry).
- **The bottom bar's Search opens Chat's Search while Chat is open**, ⌘K elsewhere (a module claims the press through `components/app/search-events.ts`) · agent · the spec names the bottom bar as an opener; ⌘K itself is unchanged · rejected: changing ⌘K inside Chat.
- **Chat's Search layout**: Browse channels' header (frame 3: title left, tools right) with the words input in the header, the FilterBar row under it, People then Messages; rows are frame 2's palette rows (avatar, marked snippet, "author · conversation", time) · agent · frame 2 draws only the palette and the find bar, so the centre surface follows the nearest drawn centre surface.
- **Not built from frame 2's palette**: its filter chips row (All / Messages / Conversations / Tasks / Notes / From / In) and Tab-to-filter · agent · the FilterBar lives in Chat's Search, one hop away through "See all in Chat" · revisit if ⌘K needs scoping.
- **The find bar doesn't paint matches inside the stream** (frame 2 marks them in message bodies); the landed message is lit by the stream's existing jump · agent · painting needs the stream's renderer to take a query; noted for a polish block. No ⌘F binding (the browser's find stays).
- **The FilterBar takes one value per filter** (`is` only): the server filters one person, one conversation, one date range.
- **Date ranges**: Today · Past 7 days · Past 30 days · Past year.

## Gotchas (area: supabase · ui)

- **supabase:** in a test, everything run under `SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated` loses the `test` schema (`permission denied for schema test`): build ids and names before switching role, and map returned ids to names after.
- **supabase:** `SET LOCAL session_replication_role = replica` loads a 100,000-row fixture into `chat_messages` without the ops' triggers and without `ALTER TABLE … DISABLE TRIGGER` (which would take an exclusive lock on the shared stack's table for the whole test).
- **supabase:** a `statement_timeout` in a function's `SET` clause doesn't bound the statement that calls it in psql; PostgREST applies it per call.

## Manual checklist (step → expect → surface)

- [ ] ⌘K, type "zolw" → messages with "żółw", the word marked → ⌘K Messages
- [ ] type "za", then "zad" → whole-word "za" first, then zadania, zadaniem, zadań → Chat's Search
- [ ] ⌘K, type a channel's name → it under Conversations; Enter opens it → ⌘K
- [ ] ⌘K → "See all in Chat" → Chat's Search with the same words → Chat's Search
- [ ] Filter → From → a person → only their messages; the link keeps it after a reload → Chat's Search
- [ ] Filter → Date → Today; Has a file → Yes → the list narrows → Chat's Search
- [ ] type "lucja" → Łucja under People; click → your direct message with her → Chat's Search
- [ ] as someone outside a private channel, search a word only it contains → nothing, also with "In: that channel" (it isn't offered) → Chat's Search
- [ ] scroll to the bottom of a long list → "Show older" continues with no repeat or gap → Chat's Search
- [ ] in a conversation, the toolbar's Search → the find bar; type a word → "1 of n", the stream lands on it; ↑ steps older; Esc closes → conversation
- [ ] with Chat open, the bottom bar's Search → Chat's Search; on Tasks it opens ⌘K → bottom bar
- [ ] ⌘J → nothing happens → anywhere

## Verify before release

- `chat_search` p95 on the real instance with spike 5's 100,000-row fixture (≤ 150 ms).
- `select alias from ts_debug('public.chat_headline', 'żółw')` on prod gives one `word` token.
- A call through PostgREST honours the function's `statement_timeout`: confirmed on local PostgREST v14.5; confirm prod runs a version that applies function settings (v12.1+), or repeat the throwaway-function probe there.
